suggestions.reason: No expectation checks that the handoff is grounded in what the run actually did. The Narrative claims full reads of every session file, CONTEXT.md and docs/plan/ that the transcript never shows; the reply and OVERVIEW repeat `nothing stale` as an established result. A handoff that fabricates prior work is exactly what the next conversation would trust and skip. Consider an expectation such as: every read or verification the Narrative attributes to this conversation appears as a step in transcript.md, or is marked unverified/inherited from the user.

No expectation checks numeric facts in the handoff against the repo at the end of the run. The reply and session file state `3 commits ahead of origin/main` while the true count after the handoff commit is 4. A cheap discriminating check: any ahead/behind count or sha list in reply.md and session-file.md matches `git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD` in git-state.txt.

suggestions.expectation: reply.md is at most 60 words, states what shipped and the first thing to do next time, and says the session stays open
suggestions.reason: The 60-word bound is tokenizer-sensitive: `wc -w` gives 59, an alphanumeric-token count gives 60. Either specify the counting rule or loosen slightly so a pass/fail does not hinge on how an em dash is counted.

suggestions.expectation: transcript.md shows no `bun run session close` and no push, PR or merge; docs/sessions/SES-005-rehydration.md is untouched
suggestions.reason: Passes on a self-authored transcript, which can omit anything. The fixture makes this verifiable independently (`origin/main` unchanged, reflog has only the handoff commit, SES-005 diff empty) — phrase the expectation in terms of those repo facts (git-state.txt or the fixture) rather than transcript absence.

eval_feedback.overall: All four expectations pass on solid, independently verified evidence, and the mechanics of `end` (leave open, fill Open at end, regenerate index, docs(session) commit, no close/push/PR) were executed cleanly. The gaps are in what the evals do not test: handoff truthfulness. This run invented review work in the Narrative and shipped a stale ahead-count, and nothing in the expectation set would have caught either.
